summary: Comprehensive testing of VYRO MVP completed. Backend: 17/17 pytest cases PASSED (auth signup/login/me with bearer, vehicle PUT, reports CRUD with AI score and XP, vote with trust delta, leaderboard sorted/sanitized, AI route suggest with truck bridge warning). Frontend: All major flows working — login, signup, map (HUDs/FAB/search), report modal (4 types post and award +10 XP), AI route modal (Claude returns ETA/distance/tips/warnings), start-navigation HUD screen, community filters + confirm/deny incrementing counts, garage save with vehicle profile, profile (XP/level/trust/badges/leaderboard), premium screen with yearly/monthly plans. Single minor UX issue found in onboarding NEXT button on web preview.

ui_bugs.issue: NEXT button uses ScrollView.scrollTo + onMomentumScrollEnd to advance slides; on React Native Web (Expo web preview) onMomentumScrollEnd is not reliably fired so the slide title/subtitle/dots and idx state do not update when NEXT is tapped (visual content stays on slide 1, though scroll offset moves). Tapping NEXT 3 times also never reaches the 'START ENGINE' state to go to /auth/signup. SKIP works fine. Recommended: drive idx via state and either programmatically setIdx alongside scrollTo, or replace ScrollView paging with a simple state-driven slide.

action_items: (MEDIUM) Fix onboarding NEXT button on web: update local idx state in next() (e.g., setIdx(idx + 1)) alongside scrollTo so the title/dots/CTA update even when onMomentumScrollEnd does not fire on RN Web. Otherwise users on web cannot progress past the first onboarding slide via NEXT — only SKIP works.

(LOW) Expo dependency mismatch warnings in expo logs: expo-linear-gradient@55.0.13 vs expected ~15.0.8 and expo-location@55.1.8 vs ~19.0.8. App still runs but consider aligning to Expo SDK expected versions.
(LOW) Multiple 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' warnings in expo logs — refactor StyleSheet entries that use shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius to use boxShadow.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: clean, single-file implementation under 360 lines, async throughout, all responses exclude _id and password_hash, JWT/bcrypt used correctly, env vars sourced from os.environ, Pydantic validation on all bodies, AI fallbacks deterministic.
Frontend uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL via src/api.ts, axios interceptor injects Bearer token from AsyncStorage('vyro_token'). All interactive elements have testID coverage.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all primary flows pass; only onboarding NEXT-on-web has a UX bug)

seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_<uuid>@vyro.app accounts via signup endpoint during pytest runs and one accident report + two votes against the existing driver1@vyro.app user. No production data modified.
